taste:
This is a savoury, meat-led burger with a straightforward mix of soft bread, juicy beef and crisp salad. The thick patty is the centre of the meal, while the lightly toasted bun stays soft enough to contrast with the lettuce. A slice of ripe tomato and thinly sliced red onion complete the fresh filling without making the description about elaborate toppings.

Served hot with a generous portion of golden chips, it suits someone who wants a familiar pub burger rather than a more involved combination. The appeal lies in the contrast between the meaty centre and fresh salad crunch. Expect an unfussy plate built around beef, bread and chips.
